events.text: The makerspace 3D printer uses PLA filament.
The makerspace 3D printer now uses PETG filament.
The makerspace 3D printer switched to ASA filament.
The reading room opens at 9 in the morning.
The reading room now opens at 8:30 in the morning.
The standard loan period for members is 14 days.
The standard loan period for members is now 21 days.
The loan period was extended because course texts had long waiting lists.
The guest wifi network is called FenGuest.
The guest wifi network is now called FenOpen.
The laser cutter requires a safety induction before first use.
The local history archive moved to the basement in 2021.
The Fenmoor library director is Ada Pike.
The book returns chute is at the north door.
The book returns chute is now at the south door.
The branch refurbishment budget is 300 thousand pounds.
The branch refurbishment budget is now 450 thousand pounds.
The late return fine is 20 pence per day.
The late return fine is now 30 pence per day.
The late return fine is 25 pence per day; 30 pence was entered by mistake.
